title: Mossy forest road
subject: Subject: an old forest road of small rounded flagstones, about 3 m across: irregular flat stones in pale grey, blue-grey and lavender, fitted close, with thin lines of green moss and dark earth in the gaps and a few fallen leaves. No glow in the seams. Night colours: moonlight in silver-blue and lavender, deep violet shadows, filtered through trees.
use: The road to Dawnroost through the forest, and the paved lookout at the Warm Roads camp.

title: Forest floor
subject: Subject: a forest floor seen from straight above, about 2 m across: dark earth mostly covered with soft green moss, fallen small leaves in brown and rust, little twigs, and a scatter of tiny white flowers, all evenly mixed. Night colours: moonlight in silver-blue and lavender, deep violet shadows, filtered through trees.
use: The ground under the trees in the forests, and the mossy verges of roads.

title: Oak bark
subject: Subject: the bark of an old oak trunk seen flat, about 60 cm across: deep vertical furrows and ridges in dark brown, umber and grey, with olive-green moss in the furrows and a little lichen, the grain running top to bottom. Night colours: moonlight in silver-blue and lavender, deep violet shadows.
use: The trunks and big branches of the oak trees.

title: Oak leaves
subject: Subject: the dense leafy crown of an oak seen up close from above, filling the picture: clusters of broad lobed leaves in dark teal, blue-green and slate, their upper edges pale silver-green in the moonlight, small dark gaps between clusters. About 2 m across. Night colours: moonlight in silver-blue and lavender, deep violet shadows.
use: The leaves of the oaks and other broad-leaved trees (for leaf cards and crowns).

title: Fir boughs
subject: Subject: the layered boughs of a fir tree seen up close, filling the picture: overlapping sprays of short dense needles in deep blue-green and teal, the tips pale silver-blue in the moonlight, dark gaps between the layers. About 1.5 m across. Night colours: moonlight in silver-blue and lavender, deep violet shadows.
use: The needles of all the fir and pine trees (for bough cards).

title: Mossy log bark
subject: Subject: the bark of an old fallen log seen flat, about 60 cm across: grey-brown cracked bark in long plates, thick olive and yellow-green moss growing over much of it, pale lichen, the grain running left to right. Night colours: moonlight in silver-blue and lavender, deep violet shadows.
use: The fallen logs in the forests.

title: Log lean-to roof
subject: Subject: the roof of a woodcutter's lean-to seen from straight above: split logs and rough planks laid side by side across two log beams, grey-brown weathered wood with moss along the joins and a few gaps. The whole roof is in the picture.
use: The roof of the woodcutter's lean-to.

title: Sun milestone
subject: Subject: a roadside milestone seen flat from the front: a round-topped upright stone, pale grey and lavender with olive moss, a sun with pointed rays carved deep into its face, a smaller mossy rock at its foot. The whole stone is in the picture.
use: The milestone on the road to Dawnroost.

title: Lantern post
subject: Subject: a roadside lantern post seen flat from the front: a square wooden post with an arm and a diagonal brace at the top, a black iron lantern with a little roof hanging from the arm on a hook, its glass glowing warm amber. The whole post is in the picture.
use: The lantern posts on the roads (Dawnroost road, the Warm Roads camp).

title: Firewood stack
subject: Subject: a stack of split firewood seen flat from the end: round and half-round log ends in pale tan and honey with growth rings, grey-brown bark round them, stacked neatly. The whole stack is in the picture.
use: The firewood stack at the woodcutter's lean-to (and log piles anywhere).

title: Fern
subject: Subject: one woodland fern seen from the side, about 70 cm tall: long arching green fronds with fine leaflets fanning out from one root, a few fronds turning bronze. Its base at the bottom. Night colours: moonlight in silver-blue and lavender, deep violet shadows.
use: Ferns under the trees in the forests.

title: Young fir
subject: Subject: one young fir tree seen from the side, about 1.5 m tall: a narrow cone of layered blue-green boughs with pale silver-blue tips, a short dark trunk at the bottom. Its base at the bottom. Night colours: moonlight in silver-blue and lavender, deep violet shadows.
use: The small firs scattered through the forests.

title: Violet undergrowth
subject: Subject: one low woodland shrub seen from the side, about 60 cm tall: thin dark stems and small dark leaves covered in tiny violet and purple flowers. Its base at the bottom. Night colours: moonlight in silver-blue and lavender, deep violet shadows.
use: The flowering undergrowth under the forest trees.

title: Shelf mushrooms
subject: Subject: a cluster of five or six shelf mushrooms growing one above another, seen from the side: flat round caps in pale cream and grey-white with darker undersides, on short stalks. Night colours: moonlight in silver-blue and lavender, deep violet shadows.
use: The mushrooms growing on fallen logs.
